method: Opened actual LeoCAD views in labelled browser review sheets; examined home composition, front elevation and site plan.
observations: Full-height green-framed glazing distinguishes the building from the house examples.
The translucent roof reads quite opaque in LeoCAD; interior planting is partly obscured, while the fountain is visible as a secondary garden feature.
revisions: Replaced stacked little windows with full-height fixed panes and added a fountain.
scope: Exterior composition review; hidden interior interfaces and physical strength are not certified.
